# Pinned configs — the world the F16 golden trace was photographed in

These are copies of `configs/` as they stood on `main` before F18 refitted the physics on
the full 2022–2025 era. `tests/env/test_engine_identity.py` and
`tests/env/fixtures/generate_f16_golden.py` load them by passing this directory as
`configs_dir`, so the golden trace is built against constants that cannot move.

**Why they exist.** The golden fixture is a photograph of a race as it ran *before* the
F16 engine extraction, and that is what makes it evidence the extraction changed no
behaviour. It is built through `F1RaceEnv`, which reads the fitted physics, so every
constant that moves breaks it. Regenerating the fixture at a post-refit commit would make
the test pass and destroy the thing it proves — it would then only show that the engine
agrees with itself today. Pinning the inputs keeps the claim about the engine tick, which
is all it was ever a claim about.

**Expect these to diverge from `configs/`, permanently.** That is the point, not drift to
be fixed. `configs/fits.yaml` already gained a `gates:` block during F18 that is
deliberately absent here.

**Do not read these as the project's constants.** `physics_2026.yaml` in particular is a
second copy of the 2026 physics table (350 kW, 4 MJ, 768 kg). The live one is
`configs/physics_2026.yaml` and it is the only one that governs anything shipped. The
header inside `physics_params.yaml` here still says it was generated by
`senna.physics.fits.run` and must not be hand-edited; true where it came from, meaningless
where it now sits — treat this whole directory as read-only.

**Scope.** Eight files, which is wider than the F18 plan's "two-circuit extract". The
plan's narrower version would have pinned only the fitted physics, leaving the trace
exposed to edits in `env.yaml`, `rivals.yaml` and `circuits.yaml`; pinning the whole input
set makes the fixture reproducible against any config change rather than only a refit.
`ablations.yaml` is absent because no golden scenario uses an ablation overlay — add it
here if one ever does, or `config.load` will raise `FileNotFoundError`.
